name: Croatian law: Ustav Republike Hrvatske (NN 56/1990 and its changes)

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: no retroactivity, with an exception for particular provisions on special grounds
default_reach.meaning: laws and other regulations of state bodies and bodies with public powers cannot have retroactive effect; on specially justified grounds only particular provisions of a law may
default_reach.authority: Ustav Republike Hrvatske, čl. 90. st. 4. i 5. (tekst NN 85/2010): "Zakoni i drugi propisi državnih tijela i tijela koja imaju javne ovlasti ne mogu imati povratno djelovanje. Iz posebno opravdanih razloga samo pojedine odredbe zakona mogu imati povratno djelovanje."
